stops.name: Ciudad Encantada
stops.detail: The enchanted town is a Spanish natural place with calcareous or limeic formations formed throughout thousands of years. It is located close to Valdecabra, at the town of Cuenca (Spain), in a large pine area of the southern part of the conquan and at an altitude of 1500 metres. It's situated at a private estate that can be accessed after payment of 6 €.)
